name: effect-rdf-workspace
description: Workspace for the @thomasfosterau/effect-rdf package family: an Effect-native RDF 1.2 toolkit — data model, syntaxes, SPARQL, SHACL and ShEx.
author: Thomas Foster <me@thomasfoster.au>

scripts.version: changeset version && vp fmt && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: vp run -r build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --access public --no-git-checks --ignore-scripts && changeset tag
